svg.title: West Australian offshore context: twelve full-domain monthly northward profiles, 2013
svg.desc: Full 60 to 116 E section at 32 S, with editorial peak search and half-peak crossings. Ten spans require resolution review. The peak changes location; neither continuity nor named-current identity is established. Missing support is hatched and is not interpreted as land. These are local diagnostic spans, not seasonal current widths.
